item.title: Proofmark — Cyber Apocalypse 2026 (mobile/RE, hard)
item.description: ARM64 reverse engineering of a Godot GDExtension. Inverting a 32-bit stream cipher to recover the flag without playing the game.

item.title: The Ashen Field — Cyber Apocalypse 2026 (crypto, very easy)
item.description: HFE public key system with base field q=2. The Frobenius maps collapse all nonlinearity; Gaussian elimination recovers the key.
